note: The order agent 'Doddy (orders for you)' (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-food-by-phone.md) has no webhook or client tools on purpose: it can only talk. It may say one server-built confirmation line for the one order the user approved; it cannot pay, send, open links, read memories or transfer. voice_agent_spec.py --agent task-call-order fails if anything else is added; the server's drift check (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSafety.ts) refuses calls if the live agent has anything else.

system_tools.name: end_call
system_tools.description: End the call after saying goodbye: once the order is confirmed, they can't take it, or anything outside the order was asked.

system_tools.name: voicemail_detection
system_tools.description: Use when a voicemail greeting or answering machine answers. Leave no message.
